note: Coverage is measured against a feed that does not build the list (PhishTank), so it is not circular. 'blockable' excludes IP-literal URLs and phishing on shared hosting, which domain-level DNS blocking cannot cover by design.

comparison.note: All three artifacts were scored against ONE PhishTank pull, so the numbers compare. 'local before' is the same publisher run from the base branch minutes earlier: it isolates what the four new feeds add from what a simple rebuild adds.

attributable_to_the_new_feeds.verdict: Small. 32,560 more names on the phone bought 24 more held-out hostnames in 3,000. Phishunt is the only one that pays for its bytes (500 names -> 16 hits); TweetFeed's 34,807 names bought 12; CSIRT Italia is malware C2 and moves a phishing benchmark by nothing at all, which is what it was adopted for.
